additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374853-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/10] OCPP connection lost CRM:00921001040
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went onsite today, and I connected my computer to the Teltonika routeur with 10.20.17.2
I saw that the SIM was written “not inserted” so I removed the SIM Card and put it back in the routeur but it changed nothing. I did a reboot of the routeur by removing and putting again the cables (RJ45 and Power supply) and then the SIM Card was written “ready” and I got the OCPP communication back online.
Then I see now that the OCPP communication is lost again. I think there is a problem with the routeur. Can you plan to send me a new one so I can change it please ?
Thank you,
Best Regards,
Yacine Kedia

additional_info.body:
Hello,
I see today that the charger is offline OCPP again, I think there is a problem with the router because when I went onsite I connected to the Teltonika OCPP router and it was written (SIM CARD not inserted). I have to do a reboot of the routeur (by unplugging the cables) manually to get back the OCPP Communication.
Can you see if there is a parameter in the routeur which is wrong please ? Or maybe think about changing the router ? Please note there is a very good network in this station and no problem with the other chargers
Thank You,
Best Regards,
